chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 265: The Treasure Hall Tension Explodes With Demons Waiting Outside
chapter_meta_description: The team considers killing Xue Hongyi for his Immortal-ranked treasure, but decides against it. Shaoyin Nong’s refusal of the treasure sets the stage for a bigger betrayal. Meanwhile, demon armies block the exit.
og_title: Desolate Era Chapter 265: The Powder Keg
og_description: Ji Ning and the team face a moral and tactical choice over an Immortal-ranked treasure, while two demon armies wait to spring their trap.
twitter_title: DE Chapter 265: No Swords Drawn, But Everyone’s Ready to Blow
twitter_description: Xue Hongyi tries to trade his treasure for safety as the team realizes the only exit is guarded by overwhelming demon forces.

lore_anchors.definition: A treasure grade above Heaven-ranked, so rare that even a past-life Loose Immortal may never have owned one. Possessing one can trigger massacres and shift the balance of entire sects.
The ultimate, instant-absorb essence of natural energy, used as currency for high-level transactions among cultivators.
The central marketplace of a commandery city, backed by the Grand Xia royal clan, where cultivation resources can be bought and sold.
A one-use escape talisman that can instantly teleport the user a fixed, long distance — a common life-saving measure in Xianxia.
A cold, proud Wanxiang Adept and Yinglong Guard member from Snowdragon Mountain; acts with pragmatic calculation and desperate survival instinct when cornered.
The fifth realm of Ki Refining; a cultivator whose soul has undergone a qualitative transformation into a Primal, gaining immense spiritual power.
A powerful Fiendgod body refiner guarding Shaoyin Nong; capable of suppressing even Wanxiang Adepts but vulnerable to coordinated army-scale attacks.
An elite soldier equipped with runic armor that allows multiple users to fuse their strength into a unified formation, forming a giant phantom for joint attacks.
A superior variant of Dao-soldier armor, capable of forming a giant, translucent specter of a hunchbacked giant holding an iron fork; signals elite military force.
